messages.content: Develop a prototype for a simple game in python. Additionally create a short description of the game in the README.MD file.

NEXT DESIGNER

Design a high-level architecture for the game prototype. The game should be simple, interactive, and include basic gameplay mechanics. Include a brief overview of the game concept, the core features, and the structure of the code. Also, outline the README.md content that will describe the game.

NEXT BROWSER

Retrieve the design document and create a README.md file that includes a short description of the game based on the design. Ensure the README.md includes the game title, a brief overview, and instructions on how to run the game.

NEXT PROGRAMMER

Write the Python code for the game prototype based on the design document. The game should be simple, with a basic loop for gameplay, user input handling, and a win/loss condition. Ensure the code is clean, well-structured, and includes comments for clarity.

NEXT TESTER

Write unit tests to verify the core functionality of the game prototype. Ensure tests cover user input handling, game loop execution, win/loss conditions, and basic error handling. Run the tests and report any failures or issues.

NEXT EXECUTER

Run the unit tests to ensure all core functionalities of the game are working as expected. Verify that the game loop, win/loss conditions, and input handling are functioning correctly. If any test fails, provide feedback to the PROGRAMMER for correction.
Code passed all tests

NEXT PROGRAMMER

Refactor the code based on the test results and reviewer feedback. Ensure the code is clean, well-documented, and follows best practices. Make sure the game logic is robust and handles edge cases properly.

NEXT BROWSER

Update the README.md file with the final game description and instructions. Ensure it includes the game title, a brief overview, the rules, and how to run the game. Make sure the README.md is clean and well-structured.

NEXT EXECUTER

Run the final code to ensure it works as expected. Verify that the game starts, processes user input, handles win/loss conditions, and allows the user to quit properly. Confirm that the README.md file is correctly formatted and contains all necessary information.
